{"id":2034559027,"question_id":3931,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781580976,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2034559027/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Process String with Special Operations I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string processStr(string s) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        bool hasletter = false;\n\n        for(auto ch : s)\n        {\n            if(isalpha(ch)) \n            {\n                ans += ch;\n                hasletter = true;\n            }\n            else if(hasletter and ch == '*') \n            {\n                ans.pop_back();\n                if(ans.empty()) break;\n            }\n            else if(hasletter and ch == '#') ans.push_back(ans.back());\n            else if(hasletter and ch == '%') reverse(begin(ans) , end(ans));\n        }\n\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"process-string-with-special-operations-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2135}
